summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload under scope impersonation
details: The package publishes to the @servicetitan npm scope and advertises itself as a React hooks library, but its package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is an obfuscated loader (hex-mangled identifiers, string-array lookup) that checks for a local bun binary; if absent, it downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts and chmods it, then invokes execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js]) against a sibling file. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line heavily obfuscated blob (string-array shuffle via WV8StW, decoder hc1jfK9, large constant table n7gIxM) with no source form shipped. A React hooks library has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time; the Bun runtime is chosen to execute the payload outside Node's tooling and lifecycle instrumentation. The dist/ React hooks content is minimal and unrelated to the preinstall dropper, consistent with a lure package impersonating ServiceTitan's corporate scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
